---
title: "Writing"
description: "From-scratch LLM builds, deep dives and practical AI engineering."
page-layout: full
body-classes: writing
toc: false
sidebar: false
listing:
  # The category chips above the rows. They are built from the categories of the posts below.
  - id: blog-chips
    template: ../_templates/category-chips.ejs
    template-params:
      all: All
      label: Categories
    contents: &posts
      - "../posts/20*.qmd"
      - "../posts/20*/index.qmd"
  # Every post as a row, newest first, and published as the RSS feed.
  - id: blog-listings
    template: ../_templates/post-rows.ejs
    template-params:
      description: true
      root: ../
    feed: true
    fields: [date, title, description, categories, reading-time]
    date-format: "YYYY-MM-DD"
    sort: "date desc"
    contents: *posts
---

::: {#blog-chips}
:::

::: {#blog-listings}
:::
